scope: Contextual SAT producer and native worker-to-exporter unit integration

admission: Only after candidate03 phases terminate and any failure is reconciled; exact snapshot manifest/readback/archive; serial own Cargo target
stop_rule: Run phases sequentially; stop first failing phase and retain immutable evidence. No automatic retry.
remaining_requirements: Executed native CLI acceptance including startup/restore and all controls
supersedes: Adds contextual SAT producer to candidate03; previous source/test records remain immutable
